newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - GOLDMAN UPGRADES PILKINGTON.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GOLDMAN UPGRADES PILKINGTON.

text.p: Shares in Pilkington Plc rose after an upgrade from Goldman Sachs.

Goldman analyst Mike Betts raised his recommendation to "trading buy" from "market outperformer" based on the view that the company's expected cost-cutting announcement will be in the order of 120 million stg a year, up from Goldman's previous estimate of 60 million.

"We think they need to and will cut by 120 million. We are comparing Pilkington with St Gobain and other glass makers and we are setting a price target of 204p within three to six months against our previous target of 170p," said Betts.
The cost-cutting news is expected in the next few weeks, Betts said.
He said he had not altered his figures and stays with an estimate of 144 million stg as a clean pre-tax profit number before what he expects to be large write-offs in 1998.
